Case :- Criminal Misc Anticipatory Bail Application U/S 438 Cr.P.C. No. - 11580 of 2022

Applicant :- Krishn Kumar Gupta
Opposite Party :- State of U.P.

Counsel for Applicant :- Vidit Narayan Mishra
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Aditya Kant Sharma
Hon'ble Mrs. Jyotsna Sharma,J.
01.Heard Sri Vidit Narayan Mishra, learned counsel for the applicant and Sri Aditya Kant Sharma,
learned A.G.A. for the State perused the papers on record.

02. This application has been moved on behalf of the applicant Krishn Kumar Gupta, seeking
anticipatory bail in case crime no. 346 of 2022 under section 498A, 323, 504, 307 I.P.C. and Section
3/4 of D.P. Act, Police Station- Madhuban Bapudham, District- Ghaziabad.

03.  As per prosecution story, the applicant who happens to be father-in-law of the victim Anchal;
who was admittedly married to son of the present applicant in 2018; was being harassed by the applicant and other members of his family for the purpose of bringing Rs. 1 Crore as dowry.
It is alleged in the F.I.R. that dispute between the two was resolved by intervention of some members of the society.
On 06.08.2022, when the victim Anchal visited her in-laws with others to collect her academic papers she was attacked by her husband Ashish and Jeth-Vinay and she sustained injuries.

04. It is contended on behalf of the applicant that the domestic dispute has been blown out of proportion and the present applicant has been en-roped just because he happens to be father-in-law Krishn Kumar Gupta vs State Of U.P. on 18 January, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/105101425/
1 and that he never tortured his daughter-in-law; a divorce proceeding is going on between his son and daughter-in-law since 2021 and to put pressure on him, this F.I.R. has been lodged.

sentences.text: 05. The anticipatory bail application is opposed on behalf of the opposite side and it is contended that the applicant has a history of three criminal cases behind him and that he has been complicit in whole of the episode and therefore, he is not entitled for anticipatory bail.

This position is not disputed that Smt. Geeta Gupta (mother-in-law) and Sweta Gupta (Nanad) and Priyanka Gupta (Jethani) of the victim who too were named in the F.I.R. with similar allegation, have been granted interim protection in Misc. application No. 11579 of 2022 by coordinate Bench of this Court vide order dated 22.11.2022 as their case was found different from that of Ashish her husband and Vinay her Jeth.
06.

I considered the nature of accusations, the attending facts and circumstances, the differences in allegations against the present applicant when compared to the allegations as imputed against Ashish and Vinay it has been contended that he is being victimized only because he happens to be father-in-law.
In my view a case for anticipatory bail is made out.

In case of breach of any of the above conditions, and in case the trial court is of the view that any attempt is being made to delay in trial the court below shall have the liberty to cancel the bail granted to the applicant.
09. It is made clear that observations made herein shall not in any way affect the learned trial Judge in forming his independent opinion at any stage of the case based on material before him.
